blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.
blocks.zh: \emph{ continuous-space} 攻击在黑盒 LLMs 中找到触发恶意行为的提示, 如过度思考, 通过采样或优化低维的 Gaussian 潜在空间, 并通过\emph{random 映射} 和最近的调试查找将其解码为文本 。 由于随机映射没有从语言中学习到,其诱因可能非常不自然,因此很容易通过输入护栏被探测到,它们产生的风险估计并不基于自然诱因. 在本文中,我们表明,同样的连续潜伏空间框架可以直接与语言上已学会的基因分配、持续扩散语言模型(dLLM)结合起来,这种模型在保留标准-古西潜质配方和下游取样或优化程序的同时去除人工随机绘图。 我们在两种情况下评价这一方法:使用\emph{ RareTrap} 进行采样估计和使用\emph{ ThinkTrap} 进行优化搜索。 我们发现,人物层面的迷惑度从10^3美元-10^7美元降至稀有特拉普的3–5美元,从20–28美元降至4.3–5.4美元。 我们还发现,模型风险估计可能因两种绘图的规模而异。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.zh: 图1: (Top)以dLLLM为基础的绘图替代随机绘图,而搜索和目标LLM则保持不变. (Bottom语). 它可以降低目标模型上的命中即时字符复杂度.

blocks.en: A novel class of attacks on black-box LLMs has recently been introduced, showing effectiveness in triggering malicious behaviors, such as overthinking ( Kumar et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) , through optimization ( Li et al., 2025b ) or sampling ( Eshra et al., 2026a ) . These attacks, which we refer to as continuous-space attacks, introduce a low-dimensional continuous latent space and use random projection matrices ( Rahimi and Recht, 2007 ) to map latent vectors to discrete prompts. This reduces adversarial prompt search to a continuous low-dimensional space while allowing the target LLM to be queried only through its outputs. We refer to this latent-to-prompt transformation as random mapping . Random mappings enable tractable continuous-space search on a black-box target model by decoupling the search process from the target model. However, despite their effectiveness, this class of attacks suffers from a key weakness: since random mappings are not learned from natural language, their geometry reflects the statistical structure of token embeddings rather than the structure of actual texts. Consequently, the discovered prompts from continuous-space attacks do not resemble natural language and, as a result, exhibit extremely high perplexity that makes them readily distinguishable from authentic instructions ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Thus, the prompts that trigger the attack may be easily flagged by the input guardrails of the LLM ecosystem. Moreover, because legitimate users are unlikely to issue prompts with such abnormally high perplexity, the LLM reliability estimates ( Eshra et al., 2026a ) based on a random mapping distribution do not provide an effective measure of LLM robustness to inputs that may organically occur in real deployment.
blocks.zh: 最近引入了针对黑盒LLMs的新型攻击类别,通过优化(Li等,2025年b)或采样(Eshra等,2026年a.)显示出触发恶意行为的有效性,如过度思考(Kumar等,2025年;Li等,2025年a.). 这些攻击,我们称之为连续空间攻击,引入了低维连续潜入空间,并使用随机投影矩阵(Rahimi and Recht, 2007)将潜入矢量映射到离散的导出. 这使得对抗性即时搜索减少为连续的低维空间,同时只允许通过它的输出来查询目标LLM. 我们把这种潜在的瞬间转变称为随机绘图。 通过将搜索过程与目标模型脱钩,随机映射可以在黑盒目标模型上进行可牵引的连续空间搜索. 然而,尽管其有效性,这一类攻击却受到一个关键弱点的困扰:由于随机绘图没有从自然语言中学习到,因此其几何反映了象征嵌入的统计结构,而不是实际文本的结构. 因此,从连续空间攻击中发现的诱因与自然语言不相上下,因而表现出极高的迷惑性,使它们很容易与真实指示相区别(Zhang等,2026年)。 因此,LLM生态系统的输入护栏可以很容易地标出触发攻击的提示. 此外,由于合法用户不太可能发出有如此异常高的复杂度的提示,基于随机映射分布的LLM可靠性估计(Eshra等,2026a)并不能有效衡量LLM稳健度,从而衡量在实际部署中可能有机地发生的投入。

blocks.en: Therefore, it is critical to develop an effective framework that generates adversarial and more natural prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, e.g., overthinking, and that can either estimate how likely such behaviors are or search for prompts that maximize them. However, there are several challenges to developing such a framework: (i) the mapping must be deterministic and preserve continuity to enable effective optimization and probability estimation; (ii) the framework must make prompts natural without giving up black-box access. Continuous-space attacks offer a natural foundation for these tasks, but their effectiveness depends on the mapping from latent to prompt space.
blocks.zh: 因此,必须建立一个有效的框架,产生对抗性和更自然的诱因,引发恶意行为,例如过度思考,并且可以估计这种行为的可能性,或者寻找尽可能扩大这些行为的诱因。 然而,制定这样一个框架存在一些挑战:(一) 绘制图必须具有决定性,必须保持连续性,以便能够进行有效的优化和概率估计;(二) 框架必须使提示自然化,而不会放弃黑箱访问。 持续空间攻击为这些任务提供了自然基础,但其有效性取决于从潜入空间到即时空间的绘图。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, the recent introduction of continuous diffusion language models (dLLMs) motivates us to propose an embarrassingly simple yet effective framework .
A dLLM can serve the role of the random mapping by transforming continuous noise into discrete text through a learned generative process, while additionally providing a representation shaped by language. Recent work demonstrates that dLLMs can generate almost entirely in continuous embedding space before realizing tokens ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , leverage learned embedding geometry for substantial likelihood gains ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and formulate generation as a mapping from a latent prior to text ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . As a result, a representation learned directly for language modeling potentially offers a more natural decoding space for continuous-space attacks.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,最近推出的连续传播语言模型(dLLM)促使我们提出一个令人尴尬的简单而有效的框架。
dLLM可以通过学习的基因过程将连续噪声转化为离散文本来服务于随机映射的作用,同时提供由语言所塑造的表达. 最近的工作表明,dLLMs可以几乎完全在连续嵌入空间中生成,然后才能实现符号(Hu等,2026年),利用所学到的嵌入几何学来获得很大的可能性收益(Yang等,2026年),并用文字之前的潜入来表示生成(Guo等,2026年). 因此,一种直接为语言建模学得的能为持续空间攻击提供更自然的解码空间.

blocks.en: Therefore, in this paper, we investigate a novel problem of whether a dLLM-based representation can serve as a drop-in replacement for the random mapping used in continuous-space attacks (Figure 1 ). Using a pretrained dLLM’s standard-Gaussian input noise as the latent keeps the mapping space continuous and keeps the attack black-box, since the dLLM needs no access to the target beyond its outputs. To this end, we ask two research questions. ( RQ1 ) Can dLLMs provide a viable alternative to the random mapping in continuous-space attacks? ( RQ2 ) Does using a dLLM-based mapping produce attack prompts that better resemble natural language? To answer these questions, we conduct a focused study using RareTrap ( Eshra et al., 2026a ) , a sampling-based attack framework for targeted behavior evaluation, and ThinkTrap ( Li et al., 2025b ) , an optimization-based attack. Together, these frameworks cover both sampling- and optimization-based approaches to continuous-space attacks, allowing us to evaluate dLLM-based representations across complementary search paradigms.
blocks.zh: 因此,在本文中,我们调查了一个新的问题,即基于dLLM的表示能否作为连续空间攻击中使用的随机绘图(图1)的倒置替代. 使用预先训练的 dLLM 标准- 高斯语输入噪声, 使绘图空间保持连续, 并保持攻击黑盒, 因为 dLLM 需要除输出外无法访问目标 。 为此,我们提出两个研究问题。 (RQ1) dLLMs能否提供连续空间攻击中随机映射的可行替代品? (RQ2)使用基于dLLM的绘图是否会产生更能与自然语言相类似的攻击提示? 为了回答这些问题,我们使用RareTrap(Eshra等,2026a)进行重点研究,这是目标行为评价的抽样攻击框架,以及ThinkTrap(Li等,2025b)进行优化攻击。 这些框架共同涵盖对持续空间攻击的取样和优化方法,使我们能够评价基于dLLM的跨互补搜索范式的表述。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: ( i ) We propose a plug-in framework in which a dLLM-based mapping substitutes the random mapping in both sampling- and optimization-based continuous-space attacks without changing the search procedure. RareTrap still finds over-generating prompts on nine of ten targets, ThinkTrap makes comparable progress across mappings, and the mapping adds only 3–11% to the compute of ThinkTrap (Findings 1, 2, and 4); ( ii ) We show that the dLLM-based mapping’s prompts are far closer to natural text. Hit prompts (that trigger over-generation) have character-level perplexity of 3–5 in RareTrap, against 10 3 10^{3} – 10 7 10^{7} under the random mapping, and 4.3–5.4 in ThinkTrap, against 20–28, and conditioning on the behavior selects more natural prompts (Findings 5–6); and ( iii ) We find that risk estimates built from unnatural prompts can misjudge a model’s risk on natural prompt inputs. The random mapping overstates over-generation on most targets and understates it on GPT-OSS-20B and Claude Sonnet 4.6. It places Claude Sonnet 4.6 about 40 × 40\times below GPT-5.4 in terms of over-generation risk, while under the dLLM-based mapping the two are within a factor of 1.6 (Finding 3).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是:(一) 我们提出了一个插件框架,在这个框架中,基于dLLM的绘图在不改变搜索程序的情况下,在采样和优化基础上的连续空间攻击中取代随机绘图。 稀有的Trap仍然在10个目标中的9个目标上发现过度生成的提示,ThinewTrap在地图绘制上取得了相近的进展,在ThinewTrap的计算上只增加了3-11%(Finds 1,2和4); (二) 显示基于 dLLM 的绘图提示更接近自然文本。 命中提示(触发超世代)在RareTrap的字符级别复杂度为3-5;在随机绘图下为10 3 10-Q 3}-10 7 10-Q 7;在ThinkTrap中为4.3-5.4;在20-28中为4;在行为上设定条件会选择更多的自然提示(发现5-6);和(iii) 我们发现,从非自然的诱因中得出的风险估计可能会误判模型对自然的即时投入的风险。 随机映射在大多数目标上夸大了多出产,并在GPT-OSS-20B和克洛德·索内4.6. 它使克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet)4.6在超生成风险方面低于GPT-5.4,而根据基于dLLLM的映射,两者在1.6个系数之内(Finance 3).

blocks.en: Together, these results show that the mapping shapes both the prompts found by continuous-space attacks and the behavior their risk estimates characterize, independently of the search procedure. Replacing the random mapping with a pretrained dLLM preserves black-box access to the target, and adds little computational cost. Furthermore, it turns continuous-space sampling methods into more reliable tools to evaluate models, based on natural prompts.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,绘图既塑造了连续空间攻击发现的提示,也塑造了其风险估计特征,独立于搜索程序。 用预先训练的dLLM来取代随机映射可以保存黑盒访问目标,并增加很少的计算成本. 此外,它将连续空间采样方法转变为更可靠的工具,根据自然提示来评价模型。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Continuous-space attacks. Continuous-space attacks build on prompt-tuning methods that optimize a low-dimensional vector projected by a fixed random matrix into a model’s embedding space, using gradients ( Wu et al., 2026 ) or, for black-box models, gradient-free search ( Sun et al., 2022 ) . ThinkTrap ( Li et al., 2025b ) uses this approach to find prompts that induce long reasoning, while RareTrap ( Eshra et al., 2026a ) uses it to estimate over-generation and degenerate repetition. Both methods decode the projected embeddings into their nearest tokens in discrete space ( Wen et al., 2023 ) . The Gaussian latent therefore defines a tractable distribution over prompts. A complementary line of work searches a learned generative model’s latent space to find inputs that remain close to natural data. Zhao et al. (2018) search a GAN’s latent space to produce natural adversarial examples, while REALISTA ( Liang et al., 2026 ) attacks LLMs by searching combinations of latent directions, each corresponding to a rephrasing of a given prompt. We combine these ideas by preserving the Gaussian latent interface of continuous-space attacks while replacing the random mapping with a learned mapping based on dLLMs.
blocks.zh: 持续空间攻击。 持续空间攻击以快速调取的方法为基础,利用梯度(Wu等,2026年)或对黑盒模型采用梯度无搜索(Sun等,2022年)优化由固定随机矩阵投射到模型嵌入空间的低维向量. ThinkTrap(Li等,2025b)使用这种方法来寻找诱发长推理的提示,而RareTrap(Eshra等,2026a)则使用这种方法来估计多生成和退化的重复. 这两种方法都解码了投影嵌入离散空间中最接近的符号(Wen等人,2023年)。 因此,高斯人潜入定义了可拉动的分布在提示上。 一个互补的工作领域是寻找一个有学问的基因模型的潜在空间,以寻找仍然接近自然数据的投入。 Zhao等人(2018年)搜索GAN的潜在空间,以产生自然对抗性的例子,而REALISTA(Liang等,2026年)通过搜索潜在方向的组合攻击LLMS,每条都对应一个给定的提示的重写. 我们通过保留连续空间攻击的高斯式潜在界面来结合这些想法,同时用基于dLLM的有学问的绘图来取代随机绘图.

blocks.en: Continuous diffusion language models. Continuous dLLMs generate text by starting from Gaussian noise in a continuous word-embedding space ( Li et al., 2022 ; Dieleman et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) or an autoencoder’s latent space ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and iteratively denoising it into representations that are then mapped to tokens. In this work, we utilize Cola-DLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , whose learned prior turns standard Gaussian noise into continuous latent representations that are then decoded into tokens. This provides a learned mapping from Gaussian inputs to input prompts, similar to how random mappings are used in continuous-space attacks.
blocks.zh: 持续传播语言模型. 连续dLLMs通过在连续的文字嵌入空间从高斯语噪声(Li等,2022;Dieleman等,2022;Hu等,2026;Yang等,2026)或自编码器潜入空间(Lovelace等,2023;Jiang等,2026)来生成文本,并迭代地将其解为表示物,然后被映射到符号上. 在这部作品中,我们使用可乐-DLM(Guo等,2026年),其所学的先行将标准高斯噪声转化为连续的潜在表示,然后被解码为符号. 这提供了从高斯语输入到输入提示的学习到的绘图,类似于在连续空间攻击中使用随机绘图的方式.

blocks.en: Readable attacks and perplexity filters. Perplexity filters ( Alon and Kamfonas, 2023 ; Jain et al., 2023 ) flag unnatural, high-perplexity prompts. These filters have motivated attacks that generate more natural, readable adversarial prompts ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Chao et al., 2023 ; Paulus et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Lucas et al., 2026 ) . However, these attacks often require gradients, log-probabilities, or access to an attacker LLM to optimize the adversarial prompts. In contrast, we improve the naturalness of continuous-space attacks by replacing their random mapping with a dLLM-based mapping, while retaining the original sampling or optimization procedure. This yields substantially lower prompt perplexity without requiring these additional sources of access or supervision, while preserving black-box access.
blocks.zh: 可读攻击和复杂度过滤器。 迷惑性滤波器(Alon and Kamfonas, 2023; Jain等, 2023) 旗帜不自然,高迷惑性提示. 这些过滤器有动机发动攻击,产生出更自然,可读的对抗性诱因(刘等,2024;朱等,2023;Chao等,2023;Paulus等,2025;郭等,2024;卢卡斯等,2026). 然而,这些攻击往往需要梯度,日志概率,或进入攻击者LLM来优化对抗性提示. 相形之下,我们通过用基于dLLM的绘图来取代它们的随机绘图,同时保留了原始的采样或优化程序来提高连续空间攻击的自然性. 这在不要求这些额外的访问或监督来源的情况下,在保留黑箱访问的同时,可以大大降低迅速的模糊性。

blocks.en: Resource exhaustion attacks. Prior work studies resource-exhaustion attacks, including sponge examples ( Shumailov et al., 2021 ) and Engorgio prompts ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , as well as overthinking attacks on reasoning models ( Kumar et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ) . NaturalSloth ( Chen et al., 2026 ) further shows that benign-looking instructions can induce excessive computation. More broadly, rare-behavior evaluation and red-teaming ( Jones et al., 2025 ; Wu and Hilton, 2024 ; Williams et al., 2026 ; Perez et al., 2022 ) depend on the distribution from which prompts are drawn. Our work keeps the attack procedures fixed and changes only this distribution, from the one induced by the random mapping to one learned from text.
blocks.zh: 资源枯竭攻击。 先前的工作研究了耗尽资源的攻击,包括海绵的例子(Shumailov等,2021年)和Engorgio poils(Dong等,2025年),以及对推理模型的攻击(Kumar等,2025年;Li等,2025年a;Li等,2025年b) 自然线条 (Chen等,2026)进一步表明,良性外观指示可能诱发过量计算. 更广义地说,稀有行为评价与红色分队(Jones等,2025;Wu和Hilton等,2024;Williams等,2026;Perez等,2022)取决于从中抽取出提示的分布. 我们的工作使攻击程序固定下来,只改变这种分布,从随机绘图所引向的分布到从文字中汲取的分布。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our approach replaces the random mapping used by existing continuous-space attacks with a mapping learned by a dLLM, while keeping the downstream search and evaluation procedure unchanged. We apply this substitution to two such attacks, RareTrap ( Eshra et al., 2026a ) and ThinkTrap ( Li et al., 2025b ) , which pair a random mapping with, respectively, a sampling-based rare-event estimator and a derivative-free optimizer. This controlled substitution allows us to isolate the effect of the prompt representation.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将现有的连续空间攻击所使用的随机绘图取而代之,取而代之的是dLLM所学的绘图,同时保持下游搜索和评价程序不变. 我们对RareTrap(Eshra等人,2026年a)和ThinkTrap(Li等人,2025年b)这两个此类攻击采用这一替代方法,它们分别将随机绘图与采样稀有事件估计器和衍生出无优化器相配. 这种有控制的替代使我们能够隔离迅速代表的影响。

blocks.en: We evaluate the dLLM-based mapping on RareTrap and ThinkTrap, measuring its effect on attack effectiveness and prompt perplexity relative to random mapping. Section 4.1 describes the protocols, baselines, and metrics. Section 4.2 asks whether the dLLM-based mapping still finds the behavior, what the change of mapping reveals about the models, and at what cost (RQ1), and Section 4.3 asks whether its prompts read as natural language (RQ2). Section 4.4 then discusses two details that affect how results compare across the frameworks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价基于dLLLM的在"稀有特拉普"和"智取特拉普"上的绘图,衡量其对攻击效果的影响,以及相对于随机绘图的即时迷惑. 第4.1节介绍了协议、基线和衡量标准。 第4.2节询问基于dLLM的映射是否仍然找到行为,映射的变化揭示了模型,成本如何(RQ1),而第4.3节询问其提示是否读取为自然语言(RQ2). 然后,第4.4节讨论两个影响各框架成果比较的细节。

blocks.en: We follow RareTrap’s over-generation protocol, enabling native thinking mode where supported and using greedy decoding with a 20,003-token output cap. The random mapping uses 40-token prompts with D = 200 D=200 . To approximately match their length, the dLLM-based mapping uses 47-token prompts, yielding D = 16 × 47 = 752 D=16\times 47=752 because Cola-DLM allocates 16 latent dimensions per token (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: As with RareTrap, we estimate the probability of triggering a response of at least 20,000 tokens using Subset Simulation at 1,000 samples per level. We keep the top 10% of each level as seeds for the next, and run at most five levels. If at least 20 of the first 200 initial samples satisfy the event, we estimate its probability using direct Monte Carlo instead. We run the dLLM-based mapping with three seeds per target and report the median, with per-seed values and 95% intervals in Appendix E . For the random-mapping baseline, we use RareTrap’s published results. For API targets, decoding uses the provider’s default temperature, and output length includes both reasoning and visible tokens.

blocks.en: We follow ThinkTrap’s overthinking protocol, which decodes the target’s responses at temperature 1.0 with a 4,096-token output cap. In each CMA-ES generation , 12 latent vectors are sampled, decoded into prompts, and sent to the target, and the search distribution moves toward those whose responses are longest. At these targets’ output lengths, each generation costs about 7,000–23,000 tokens (Table 3 ), so the 10,000–100,000-token budgets ThinkTrap reports would allow only a few generations, which may be too few to measure search progress. We therefore use a budget of 300,000 generated tokens, which allows 13–40 generations. The dLLM-based mapping’s latent is Cola-DLM’s input noise for one generation block, 16 dimensions for each of the 15 tokens generated after a one-token prefix, so D = 240 D=240 , thus matching ThinkTrap’s 15-token prompt. We run both mappings with the same budget and targets, over three seeds.

blocks.en: Unlike the near-zero cost of random mapping, dLLM-based mapping adds a fixed cost per prompt, independent of the target model. Cola-DLM has approximately 2.3B parameters and generates a fixed number of blocks per prompt, whereas target-model inference costs scale with model size and response length. Figure 3 shows the dLLM-based mapping’s share of compute on three models across the ThinkTrap runs. The dLLM-based mapping accounts for 3–11% of total compute. Its share is highest for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the smallest target, and lowest for Phi-4-reasoning, which produces the longest responses. Because the search procedure remains unchanged, this mapping cost constitutes the entire computational overhead of the substitution. blocks.en: 4.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: Under RareTrap’s greedy decoding, nearly every sample loops verbatim to the cap under both mappings, yielding an estimated p ℱ ​ ( τ ) p_{\mathcal{F}}(\tau) of 1 (Table 2 ). Under ThinkTrap’s sampling at temperature 1.0, at most 3% of responses reach the cap. Phi-4-reasoning’s outputs are the longest of the three targets (median 1,500–1,900 tokens), limiting the number of generations and leaving neither mapping able to increase mean output length (Table 3 ).

The mappings produce similar token counts in their respective vocabularies. However, random-mapping prompts in RareTrap are much shorter in characters (about 40 vs. 200), since they consist mostly of single rare characters. ThinkTrap prompts are 60–77 characters under both mappings. Being shorter than our RareTrap prompts may partly explain why our ThinkTrap prompts have higher character-level perplexity (4.3–5.4 vs. 3–5 for RareTrap), since early characters have less preceding context. The two settings also score different prompts, the 12 longest-output prompts in ThinkTrap and the hits in RareTrap.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Substituting the random mapping of continuous-space attacks with a pretrained continuous dLLM preserves the search procedure with limited additional compute, while producing prompts far closer to natural text. In RareTrap, hit prompts have character-level perplexity of 3–5, compared with 10 3 10^{3} – 10 7 10^{7} under the random mapping. The resulting over-generation probability estimates can shift in either direction, changing the relative risk estimates for models such as Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4. Under ThinkTrap, the dLLM-based mapping’s prompts stay far more natural.
blocks.zh: 以预先训练的连续dLLM来取代连续空间攻击的随机映射,保留了搜索程序,附加计算有限,同时产生出更接近自然文本的提示. 在"RareTrap"中,被击中的提示在人物级别上具有3–5的迷惑性,而相较于在随机绘图下,10 3 10^{3}- 10 7 10^{7}. 由此产生的多生成概率估计可以朝两个方向转变,从而改变克洛德·索内特4.6和GPT-5.4等模型的相对风险估计. 在ThinkTrap下,基于dLLM的地平线绘制的提示仍然更加自然.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The random-mapping baseline is a single published run, and our smallest estimates rest on few distinct prompts. We use a single dLLM, sampled unconditionally, so its prompts read as generic text rather than as typical user requests, and our estimates describe that distribution rather than real deployment traffic. We only consider over-generation, and measure naturalness by perplexity rather than human judgment. The ThinkTrap comparison covers only a few targets.
blocks.zh: 随机绘图基线是一次公布的运行,我们最小的估算依赖于几个明显的提示。 我们使用一个单一的dLLM,无条件采样,所以它的提示读作通用文本,而不是典型的用户请求,我们的估计描述的是这种分布而不是真正的部署流量. 我们只考虑超世代,用迷惑而不是人类判断来衡量自然。 ThinkTrap的比较只涵盖几个目标.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work has dual-use implications. More natural over-generation prompts may be harder to distinguish from ordinary user requests than prompts produced by random mappings, although a calibrated character-level perplexity filter still flags most of them (Table 5 ). We report this method to support the evaluation and mitigation of costly model behaviors, using a public model and established search procedures. Our findings motivate output-side defenses, including repetition detection and per-request reasoning budgets. The prompts are benign in content, and the risk studied is excessive computation, which can increase inference cost and latency, rather than the generation of harmful content. We evaluate API models through Amazon Bedrock under its standard terms of service and impose bounded generation budgets. No human subjects or personal data are involved in this study.
blocks.zh: 这项工作具有双重用途影响。 与随机映射生成的提示相比,比较自然的多生成提示可能更难与普通用户请求相区分,尽管一个校准的字符级通透滤器仍然标出其中的大部分(表5). 我们报告这种方法是为了支持对代价高昂的模型行为的评估和减轻,使用公共模型和既定的搜索程序。 我们的调查结果激励了产出方面的辩护,包括重复检测和每个请求的推理预算。 提示在内容上是良性的,所研究的风险是过度计算,这可以增加推论成本和耐久性,而不是产生有害内容. 我们通过亚马逊·贝德罗克(Amazon Bedrock)根据其标准服务条款来评价API模型,并强制实行有限度的发电预算. 本研究不涉及人类学科或个人资料.

blocks.en: Appendix A dLLM-based mapping details
blocks.zh: 基于 dLLM 的绘图细节

blocks.en: We use the input noise of Cola-DLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) as the search latent. Cola-DLM generates text in blocks of 16 positions, each generated from Gaussian noise of shape 16 × 16 16\times 16 . We split a single vector z z into these noise blocks and run the released inference procedure with them in place of the noise it would otherwise sample. Under fixed inference settings, a fixed batch size, and greedy decoding, this defines a deterministic mapping from z z to text.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Cola-DLM(Guo等,2026年)的输入噪声作为搜索潜伏. Cola-DLM生成16个位置的块状文字,每个块由形状为16×16 16\times 16的高斯噪音所生成. 我们把一个单向量 z z 分成这些噪声块 用它们来进行释放的推论程序 来代替它本来会取样的噪声 在固定的推论设置,一个固定的批量大小,和贪婪的解码下,这定义了从z z到文本的决定性映射.

blocks.en: We initialize each sample with a single document-boundary token ( <|endoftext|> ) so that generation is unconditional. This token takes the first position of the first block and receives no noise. With L L generated positions the latent dimension is D = 16 ​ L D=16L , with L = 47 L=47 ( D = 752 D=752 , three blocks) for RareTrap and L = 15 L=15 ( D = 240 D=240 , one block) for ThinkTrap. We use the released inference settings, namely 16 Euler steps, classifier-free guidance scale 7.0, repetition penalty 1.1, and greedy decoding. Cola-DLM always generates all L L positions, and the prompt is cut at the first end-of-sequence token.
blocks.zh: 我们以一个单一的文档边界符号(QQendoftext)初始化每个样本, 此符号取出第一个块的第一个位置,不会收到噪音. 由于L L 生成位置,潜在维度为 D = 16 L D = 16L,其中L = 47 L (D = 752 D = 752, 三块)用于RoreTrap,L = 15 L (D = 240 D = 240,一块)用于ThinkTrap. 我们使用释放的推论设置,即16个欧拉步骤,无分级制导尺度7.0,重复罚则1.1,以及贪婪的解码. Cola-DLM总是生成所有LL位置,而提示被剪接到第一末端符.

blocks.en: Appendix G Cost of the dLLM-based mapping

blocks.en: The random mapping needs only a matrix product and a nearest-neighbor lookup per prompt, so its cost is negligible next to querying the target. The dLLM-based mapping instead runs Cola-DLM once per prompt. We profiled it at RareTrap’s settings ( L = 47 L=47 , D = 752 D=752 ) with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B as the target, on a single A100 GPU. Mapping a batch of 10, 25, or 50 prompts took 11, 16, and 25 seconds, less than the time the target took to decode the first 256 response tokens for the same batch, while decoding up to the 20,003-token cap is projected, by linear extrapolation from those 256 tokens, to take roughly 100–200 times longer than the mapping. The number of search steps is unchanged, since both mappings use the same number of samples per Subset Simulation level and the same population per CMA-ES generation. Under ThinkTrap’s fixed token budget, however, the dLLM-based mapping completes fewer generations, because its prompts draw longer responses (Table 3 ).

blocks.zh: 附录H 复杂度测量细节

blocks.en: Prompts are scored as raw text with the scoring model’s tokenizer, adding a beginning-of-sequence token where the tokenizer defines one and predicting each token from the preceding ones, and no chat template is applied. Sequences are right-padded so padding does not affect the causal positions of real tokens. Token-level perplexity is exp \exp of the mean per-token NLL. Character-level perplexity divides the total NLL of the prompt by its number of Unicode characters before exponentiating. Medians are over unique prompts. Target models were loaded in bfloat16 when used as scorers. The reference scorer is the base model Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) ( meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B ), which is not one of the targets, run in float32, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B is fine-tuned from it. The filter thresholds of Table 5 are the 99th and 95th percentiles of the reference scorer’s perplexity on the 735 OASST1 prompts, which were sampled to match the word-count distribution of the dLLM-based mapping’s level-0 prompts.
